Reading the graph: the wave crosses zero (going upward) at x = 0, reaches a maximum of 3 near x ≈ 0.79, returns to zero near x ≈ 1.57, hits a minimum of −3 near x ≈ 2.36, and completes a full cycle near x ≈ 3.14. Successive peaks (≈0.79, ≈3.93, ≈7.07) are spaced about 3.14 apart.

So the period is about 3.14 ≈ π, which means the angular frequency is b = 2π/π = 2 (an integer), consistent with y = 3 sin(2x).

Period = 2π / 2 = π.

\boxed{\pi}
